Everything checks out. `bun run typecheck`, `bun run build`, `bunx guren check`, and `bun test` all pass.

## Summary

I updated `app/Http/Controllers/DashboardController.ts` to query the signed-in user's post count (`Post.where({ authorId }).count()`) and their 5 most recent posts (`.orderBy('createdAt', 'desc').orderBy('id', 'desc').limit(5).get()`, projected to `{ id, title }`), and pass `postCount`/`recentPosts` into the Inertia response alongside the existing `user` prop. In `resources/js/pages/dashboard/Index.tsx` I added a new panel below the "Signed in as" panel showing "You have N post(s)" and either a linked list of recent post titles (`/posts/<id>`) or an empty-state message with a link to `/posts/create`. Regenerated codegen (`bunx guren codegen`) and added `tests/DashboardController.test.ts`, which exercises the empty state and verifies that only the signed-in user's posts are counted/listed, newest-first, capped at 5, using `TestApp.fromApp(app)` with `actingAs()` and the `X-Inertia` header.
